title: JAILJUDGE: A Comprehensive Jailbreak Judge Benchmark with Multi-Agent Enhanced Explanation Evaluation Framework
reasoning: The JAILJUDGE benchmark evaluates Large Language Models (LLMs) based on their adherence to safety policies which explicitly include 'Ethics and Morality' as a core rule (Figure 7). The paper's framework and human annotation process are centered around determining whether LLM responses violate basic ethical and moral standards.
